title: Uniform Stability of the Spherical Laughlin Gap

issues.location: Sec. 3 (locality.tex): Lemmas locality:frame, locality:dynamics, locality:filters, locality:difference; Sec. 4 Prop. pinning:generator ('weighted row bounds give size ...')
issues.description: The analytic locality machinery (frame decay, polynomial Lieb–Robinson propagation, weighted-difference estimates, affine-subtracted source sizes) is given as sketches that assert uniform constants. I found no error in it, but I did not check it line by line. Every uniform-in-q constant in Sections 4–8 depends on it.
issues.evidence: For example, Prop. pinning:generator only says 'The weighted row bounds give size Cw^2|a''(m)| whenever (affine-symbol-hypothesis) holds', and Lemma locality:filters is proved by 'Integrate (polynomial-propagation)'. The spot checks I did (Lemma locality:calculus(iii), the gap argument along the pinning path, the occupation gap in Lemma flags-polar) all hold.

main_claim: For q = 3(N−1), there are λ*, Δ* > 0 and N* such that for all N ≥ N*, all measurable real φ with ‖φ‖∞ ≤ 1, and all |λ| ≤ λ*, the N-particle operator H_{N,q} + λ·dΓ(T_q(φ)) (V_1 pseudopotential plus a lowest-Landau-level-projected one-body potential) has a unique ground state and a spectral gap ≥ Δ*.
sibling_notes: Family 269 had no prior entries on the board. A reusable result for companion papers: the retained-block inequality H^2 ≥ c0·H + L4(W4 R_hi W4*), Appendix Prop. retained-blocks. Its certificate (seven integer rows) reproduces exactly from the printed formulas.
